description: Repairs r-def-expr-sql/sql-update-assignment-order: the UPDATEs shared state across statements. Asks how Database.Execute (dbFailOnError) evaluates UPDATE assignments over Dm. Before every statement Dm and One are reseeded by SQL; after it RecordsAffected, Errors and the rows (ID, V, N, S) are read. The primary-key shift (ID + 1, then ID - 1 for ID > 1) is one group on one reseed, as originally. Fixture r-fix-expr-sql-expr is opened on a writable fresh copy through DAO.DBEngine.120; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field. Each statement is preceded by a marker (a DROP TABLE of a table that does not exist, which always fails), so DBEngine.Errors read after the statement shows that statement's own failure or the marker's, never an older one. Where Field Precision and Scale are read, the recordset is first positioned on its first row (MoveFirst) and DecimalPlaces is not read.
